title: Postal Affairs and Official Mail Program - Military Postal Activity
summary: Commands operating a Military Postal Activity (MPO, UMR, or OMC). 112 items across the program.

source.title: IGMC Functional Area Checklist - Postal Affairs and Official Mail Program - Military Postal Activity
source.publisher: Inspector General of the Marine Corps

items.question: Is an Installation/Base order for Postal Affairs published?
Has the Installation Commander appointed in writing a MCPO or MPO supervisor that possess a high moral standard to maintain operational control of Postal Affairs?
Are the designation documents correctly completed for personnel?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2(c)(6), (7) and Chap 2, par 4

items.question: Does the MPO maintain an updated profile in AMPS?
Are personnel removed for cause and reported by the MPA?
Are terminating designation documents for personnel correctly processed and maintained?
Are MPOs conducting local Primary Military Occupational Specialty (PMOS) Training and Readiness (T&R) events and continuum training?
references: MPM 2.14.h, Sect 13 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 7a

items.question: Does the military postal facility meet space and structural criteria requirements?
references: MPM 8.2, Sect 15 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 2

items.question: Does the MPO meet physical security requirements?
references: DODI O-2000.16, Vol. 1 & Vol 2, DOD UFC 4-020-01, MPM Sect 8, and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 15

items.question: Does the MPA maintain a Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP) and update annually?
Does the MPA maintain a facility and equipment upgrade plan?
Does the MPO supervisor maintain a current list of individuals that are issued keys to the post office?
Are assigned duplicate keys/safe combinations and passwords safeguarded and sealed in an envelope/PS Form 3977?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, 3-8, MPM 8.2f, 38.2b and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 19c

items.question: Are proper procedures followed when preparing, maintaining, and opening a PS Form 3977?
Is mail properly scanned?
references: MPM Sect 26 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 27

items.question: Has the Postal Finance Officer (PFO) completed quarterly/annual MPO inspections?
Are unannounced audits on postal accounts conducted?
references: MPM 2.14.g, Sect 25 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 35a

items.question: Has the Custodian of Postal Effects (COPE) completed unannounced audits of Postal Clerks’ accounts?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 13, MPM Sect 25, and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 35b

items.question: Is the PS Form 1590 annotated correctly for receipt, transfer, or return of capital/sensitive equipment?
Are payment card industry terminal inspections completed as required?
references: MPM 24.2.h and i and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 35.a.(2)

items.question: Are PS Form 17 – Stamp Requisitions correctly prepared, submitted, and received?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 13, MPM 24.2j and k

items.question: Are Money Orders correctly maintained and distributed?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 10, 13 and MPM 24.2, k(6)

items.question: Are Change of Custody and financial accounts exchanged for clerks absent for more than five consecutive workdays, but less than thirty-one total days?
Are assigned stock and funds protected in safes, lockable drawers, or cash boxes?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 3 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 19c

items.question: Does the MPO maintain records for financial accounts?
references: USPS Handbook F101 Appendix D, MPM 25.2m, 38.1c, Appendix 38A and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 35b

items.question: Are window clerks authorized in writing to retain fixed credit stocks in excess of $1,000?
Are overages/shortages in excess of tolerance limits reconciled properly?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 13, MPM 25.1e and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 35b

items.question: Does the MPA provide support to only authorized patrons?
Does the MPA report suspicious money order transactions on PS Form 8105?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 10 and MPM 24.2.c(1)

items.question: Is mail properly accepted?
Does the MPA make deposits as required?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 9-1 and MPM 24.2.f and g

items.question: Are Mail Handling Procedures (MHP) and floor changes being prepared and distributed for deploying units?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2, h(2), Chap 2, par 30c, and Chap 3, par 28 (a), (b)

items.question: Does the activity participate in Marine Expeditionary Force (MEF) operational planning teams?
Does the activity maintain current contingency operation postal support plans?
Are contingency postal kits upgraded and tested semi-annually?
references: MPM Appendix 5A.1b(3), 16.1 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 16f

items.question: Has the MACOM conducted an annual MPO field exercise for practical T&R skill application?
Are Postal Offense(s) properly reported and updated?
references: MPM Sect 35, MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2b(6) and Chap 7

items.question: Is a postal supply clerk designated in writing?
Is PS Form 1586 – Supply Record, with location numbering system, utilized to meet current operational requirements?
Are United States Postal Service (USPS) supplies and equipment controlled and maintained?
references: MPM Sect 16, MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 16c-e and par 19d

items.question: Are scales accurate with validated calibration records?
references: USPS Postal Operations Manual Issue 9, Chap 1, Sect 125.323 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 16g

items.question: Does the MPA properly transport mail and postal items?
Do Postal Clerks understand the receipt and delivery instructions for absentee ballots/election material?
references: MPM 19.2.a(1), Sect 39 and MCO 5110.4B Chap 2, par 26

items.question: Are Absentee Balloting Materials, Express, Priority, First Class, Accountable, and IDS Correspondence processed and available within one duty day of receipt.?
Is Standard and Bulk Rate Mail; as well as IDS Parcels processed and available within two duty days of receipt?
Does the MPA use customs clearance documents for postal items transiting international boundaries?
Does the MPA nest barcoded postal items by transportation category? Reference MPM 27.2 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 31
Does the MPA have receptacle nesting and dispatching certificate for all users? Reference MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 31e
Are Military postal activities utilizing the most current AMPS Receptacle Nesting/Dispatching procedures manual?
Are GTC clearance for postal items achieved?
Are postal items received and dispatched at least 5 days a week?
Does the MPA properly dispatch IDS items?
Are designation documents on file for Unit Mailroom personnel?
Is mail delivered to the authorized addressee or agent?
Has the MCPO assigned in writing a primary Registry Clerk?
Do MPA personnel handling "Registered" official mail have at least an interim or adjudicated Secret clearance?
Is access to the registered cage restricted?
Do registered mail personnel know how to report irregularities when receiving registered mail?
references: USPS Handbook DM 901, Chap 6, par 6-3, MPM Sect 32 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 32

items.question: Is the registry section constructed and equipped with GSA-approved locks/containers?
Is a SF Form 702 for safes, lockable containers, or registry cages completed and maintained?
Is there a chain of receipts, using approved USPS and DD Forms, for registered mail?
Is correct and supporting documentation for the registered mail process maintained?
Is registered mail processed with the highest security measures?
Is personal registered mail handled correctly?
Is registered mail accepted and delivered by/to an authorized patron/agent?
Are proper procedures followed at the close of each business day, shift change, as applicable?
Are proper procedures followed opening/accessing the registry cage?
Is directory service provided for mail with unknown delivery address, i.e., EDA, general delivery, UAA, etc.?
references: MPM Sect 21 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 34

items.question: Are mail delivery receptacles assigned with required forms and information? MCO 5110.4B, Chap 4, par 2 and 3
Are correct receptacle maintenance and records procedures followed?
Are mail delivery receptacles issued to authorized patrons?
Is correctly addressed mail placed in assigned receptacles?
Are the mail delivery receptacles checked bi-weekly for excessive mail accumulation, old mail, or non-use?
Are customers notified of large mail items or excess mail accumulation using a PS Form 3907?
Is DD Form 2258 - Temporary Mail Disposition Instructions used to indicate the status of addressee and proper mail disposition?
Are mail delivery receptacles correctly closed?
Are mail delivery receptacle key lock cylinder/combination procedures followed?
Is general delivery service provided to mail addressed for members due to arrive?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 26h and Chap 4, par 4

items.question: Are USPS mail collection boxes being maintained and properly secured?
Do the Postal Clerks understand the detection/notification instructions for potential mail bombs and suspicious mail?
Does the MPA submit seizure reports within one workday of postal items confiscated?
Are Postal Net Alert (PNA) properly reported and updated?
references: MPM Sect 31 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2b(6)

items.question: Has the postal activity established a Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) section?
Are Marine Corps Postal Inspectors appointed and assigned to the QA/QC section?
Does the MPA provide training for postal personnel, Unit Official Mail Managers (OMM)s, Unit Mail Officers, and Unit Mail Clerks?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2d(10) and Chap 3, par 5

items.question: Are Installation/Operational Force (OPFOR) Military Postal Activity (MPA)/Military Postal Service (MPS) inspections effectively conducted each fiscal year?
references: MPM 36.1.c, 36.2.a., MCO 5110.4B, par 4b(3)(c), Chap 1, par 2b(3) and Chap 2, par 35

items.question: Are Unit Mailroom (UMR) inspections conducted each quarter?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2g(4) and Chap 3, par 14e

items.question: Are corrective action reports received from MPAs (MPO, UMR, OMC) for findings and failed/ineffective inspections?
Are Installation/OPFOR MPA/MPS inspections forwarded to appropriate Major Command (MACOM)?
references: MCO 5110.4B, par 4b(3)(d), par 4b(4)(c) and Chap 2, par 35e

items.question: Are MACOM OPFOR inspection reports retained?
references: MPM 36.2b, MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2b(4) and Chap 2, par 35a(2)

items.question: Does the QA/QC officer/chief provide Fiscal Year (FY) summary inspection report to MCICOM?
Is the MPO free of personal effects and funds in work areas where mail is processed, or retail services are provided?
Has the Command appointed personnel in writing the grade of E-6/GS-9 or above as the OMM?
references: DODI 4525.09, 3.2g, MPM 41.2a-c, MCO 5110.4B, 4b(6)(a) and Ch 5, par 2

items.question: Has the installation established an Official Mail Center?
Is a postage stamp inventory maintained for the authorized unit?
Are postage meters/stamps correctly secured?
Are assigned duplicate meter keys/safe combinations and passwords safeguarded and sealed in an envelope/PS Form 3977?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, 3-8, and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 5, par 28d

items.question: Are postage stamp stock audits conducted?
Is a daily record of meter register correctly recorded?
references: MPM Appendix 25A, Table 5, Steps 1-2 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 5, par 26

items.question: Is PS Forms 3533 Application for Voucher for Refund of Postage and Fees, processed and submitted?
references: USPS DMM 604, 9.3 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 5, par 27

items.question: Has the OMM analyzed the record of postage expended weekly?
Are appropriated funds for postage properly used?
Does the OMM maintain a copy of the most current edition of the listed publications/directives?
Are cost saving measures applied to official mailings?
Is the classification of official items correctly endorsed?
Are the Priority Mail Express provisions correctly followed?
references: MPM 41.1c, e, g and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 5, par 17a

items.question: Are permit mailings correctly used?
references: USPS Handbook F-101, Chap 16 and MCO 5110.4B, Chap 5, par14c-e

items.question: Is a structured, documented, and viable OMP training program provided?
references: DODI 4525.09, 2.2k, MPM 41.2.j, MCO 5110.4B, Chap 2, par 7 and Chap 5, par 4

items.question: Are Official Mail Program (OMP) inspections effectively conducted each fiscal year?
references: MCO 5110.4B, par 4b(3)(c), Chap 1, par 2g(5), and chap 5, par 6

items.question: Are OMP inspections forwarded to the appropriate MACOM?
Are postage expenditure reports submitted?
Has the OMM met the supervision requirements?
references: MCO 5110.4B, Chap 1, par 2k and Chap 5 par 5
